rationale: Transport-only change in browser_capture: the capture browser is driven over Chrome's --remote-debugging-pipe (CDP on fds 3/4) instead of an unauthenticated 127.0.0.1 DevTools TCP port, so no local process can attach while a capture runs. Page commands now reach the page via Target.attachToTarget(flatten) on the same browser connection. What is captured, how DesignIR/materialization is produced, the Fetch network guard, profile isolation, guardian custody and packaging are unchanged; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves. Unit 122/122, lifecycle 16/16 and real-Chrome integration 38/38 match or extend the baseline.
